findings.source_quote: proclaimed a fast throughout all the land of Judah
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “akatangaza sikukuu ya kufunga” kuwa “akatangaza kufunga”.
findings.translation_quote: akatangaza sikukuu ya kufunga

findings.source_quote: art not thou God in heaven? ... so that none is able to withstand thee?
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Je, si wewe Mungu uliye mbinguni?” na “hata hakuna awezaye kukupinga?” katika sehemu hizi za nukuu.
findings.translation_quote: huna wewe, si wewe Mungu mbinguni? ... hata mtu hapaswi kukupinga?

findings.source_quote: even without the dreaded “what ifs” becoming reality ... fall exhausted at my Lord’s feet
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “hata bila yale mambo ninayohofia kwamba huenda yakatokea kutimia” na “kuanguka nimechoka miguuni pa Bwana wangu”.
findings.translation_quote: hata bila yale “kama” yaukwera kuwa kweli ... kuanguka nimechoka migongoni mwa Bwana wangu

findings.source_quote: O our God, wilt thou not judge them?
findings.suggested_fix: Badili swali kuwa “Ee Mungu wetu, je, hutawahukumu?”
findings.translation_quote: Ee Mungu wetu, je, hutaliwa hao?

findings.location: html, aya ya 7 na 8, mistari 15 na 17
findings.source_quote: Be not afraid nor dismayed ... fear not, nor be dismayed
findings.suggested_fix: Katika sehemu zote mbili, badili “msihofu wala msipate moyo” kuwa “msiogope wala msifadhaike”. Tafsiri ya sasa inakataza kupata moyo badala ya kuondoa kufadhaika.
findings.translation_quote: Msihofu wala msipate moyo ... msihofu wala msipate moyo

findings.source_quote: rather than making myself vulnerable to others ... I find the strength of God through His people
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “badala ya kuwafungulia wengine moyo wangu na kuwaonyesha udhaifu wangu” na “ninapata nguvu za Mungu kupitia watu Wake”.
findings.translation_quote: badala ya kufanya mwenyewe kuwa mwoga mbele ya wengine ... napatia nguvu za Mungu kupitia watu Wake

findings.source_quote: Tomorrow go ye down against them ... set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the LORD
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Kesho shukeni dhidi yao ... jipangeni, simameni imara, mwone wokovu wa BWANA”.
findings.translation_quote: Kesho mnendeni nao ... jisahihisheni, simameni mtulivu, mone wokovu wa BWANA

findings.source_quote: God tells my heart to sit still without fear and let Him do the fighting
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Mungu anauambia moyo wangu utulie bila hofu na kumwacha Yeye apigane”.
findings.translation_quote: Mungu anasema moyo wangu usimame tulivu bila hofu na Aendelee kupigana

findings.source_quote: Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground
findings.suggested_fix: Badili kuwa “Yehoshafati aliinamisha kichwa chake hadi uso wake ukagusa ardhi”.
findings.translation_quote: Yehoshafati alijikubali mguu na uso zake ardhini

findings.source_quote: I will see God do miracles ... And that causes me to worship
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “nitaona Mungu akifanya miujiza” na “Na hilo linanifanya nimwabudu”.
findings.translation_quote: nitaona Mungu afanye mafundisho ... Na hilo linanifanya nimbuke

findings.source_quote: believe his prophets ... he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “waaminini manabii wake” na “akawateua waimbaji wamwimbie BWANA na kuusifu uzuri wa utakatifu”.
findings.translation_quote: amini nabii wake ... aliwaita waimbaji kwa BWANA, na wawe wakiwapongeza uzuri wa utakatifu

findings.location: html, aya ya 12, sentensi ya kwanza
findings.source_quote: I would have liked to see that huge army going out of the city, singing.
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Ningependa kuliona jeshi hilo kubwa likitoka mjini huku likiimba.”
findings.translation_quote: Nilipenda kuona jeshi hilo kubwa likiishi toka mjini, wakiiimba.

findings.source_quote: the LORD set… [an ambush] against the children of Ammon, [and] Moab
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “BWANA akaweka… [mtego wa kuvizia] dhidi ya wana wa Amoni, [na] Moabu”.
findings.translation_quote: BWANA akafanya ... [kufanyia) mashambulizi dhidi ya wana wa Amini, [na] Moabu

findings.source_quote: saw that their enemies had destroyed each other
findings.suggested_fix: Badili kuwa “waliona kwamba maadui zao walikuwa wameangamizana”.
findings.translation_quote: waliona maadui zao walikuwa wametwikwa wenyewe

findings.source_quote: riches and spoils ... collect ‘spoils’ ... all their spoil
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “shinani” kuwa “nyara” katika sehemu zote tatu. Katika aya ya 14, tumia pia “walikusanya nyingi kiasi kwamba hawakuweza kuzibeba zote” badala ya “hawakuweza kubebwa nayo wote”.
findings.translation_quote: mali na shinani ... kukusanya ‘shinani’ ... shinani zao zote; hawakuweza kubebwa nayo wote

findings.source_quote: They came again to their homes in Jerusalem with singing, and harps, and trumpets
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Walirudi nyumbani kwao Yerusalemu wakiimba, wakiwa na vinubi na tarumbeta”.
findings.translation_quote: Walikaribishwa nyumbani kwao Yerusalemu wakiwa wakiimba, na vyuma vya mrija, na tarumbeta

findings.source_quote: then Jehoshaphat’s realm was quiet
findings.suggested_fix: Badili kuwa “ndipo ufalme wa Yehoshafati ukatulia”.
findings.translation_quote: basi ufalme wa Yehoshafati ukawahulusia

findings.source_quote: There is rest ‘round about’ ... the strength that is within us
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Kuna utulivu ‘pande zote’” na “nguvu iliyo ndani yetu”.
findings.translation_quote: Kuna mapumziko ‘kando yake’ ... nguvu iliyotuwepo ndani

findings.source_quote: Lessons From Second Chronicles Twenty
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Mafunzo Kutoka Mambo ya Nyakati wa Pili, Sura ya Ishirini”.
findings.translation_quote: Mafunzo Kutoka Katika Mambo ya Pili ya Mambo ya Nyakati ishirini

findings.source_quote: turning them over and over in my mind; When we all pray together; He will show my heart; the strongest man; the next three days; no one can match
findings.suggested_fix: Rekebisha sarufi na tahajia: “nikiyawaza tena na tena”; “Tunapoomba sote pamoja”; “Atauonyesha moyo wangu”; “mtu mwenye nguvu zaidi atetemeke”; “siku tatu zilizofuata”; “hakuna awezaye kulingana nazo”.
findings.translation_quote: nikiwazungusha mfululizo akilini mwangu; Tunapokuwa tumsali pamoja; Atataonyesha moyo wangu; mtu mwenye nguvu aitetemeka; siku tatu zilizoifuwa; hakuna anayezoshindana nayo

findings.source_quote: A glowing lantern on a snowy path at night
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “Lantern” kuwa “Taa ya kandili”.
findings.translation_quote: Lantern inayong'aa kwenye njia yenye theluji usiku
